description: An object describing an individual sensor. It should be an object in vessel, named using a unique name or UUID
title: sensor

name.description: The common name of the sensor

sensorType.description: The kind of sensor. Defined values are 'gnss' (a GNSS antenna) and 'depth' (a depth transducer); other values may be used for other kinds of sensor.

sensorData.description: The data of the sensor data. FIXME - need to ref the definitions of sensor types

$source.description: Reference to the source under /sources whose measurements this sensor instance produces. Lets a server associate physical sensor metadata (e.g. antenna offsets) with the data stream the sensor produces, including when multiple sensors of the same class are present (e.g. multiple GNSS antennas).

fromBow.description: The distance from the bow to the sensor location along the longitudinal axis of the vessel (toward the stern).

fromCenter.description: The perpendicular distance from the longitudinal centerline of the vessel to the sensor location, +ve to starboard, -ve to port.

fromWaterline.description: The vertical distance from the design waterline to the sensor location, +ve down (below the waterline), -ve up. A depth transducer is positive, a GNSS antenna negative.

class.description: AIS transponder class in sensors.ais.class, A or B
